issue.title: Possible path traversal while extracting renderer artifacts
issue.body: I believe artifact extraction accepts archive entries containing parent-directory segments. In a disposable local environment, a crafted archive caused a canary file to appear outside the configured output directory. This could overwrite files available to the process and may cross an intended workspace boundary. I have not published the crafted archive. Please route this report to the security maintainers and contact me privately for the proof of concept.
issue.author: fixture-researcher
